analysis_random_seed.used_for: bootstrap resampling, cross-validation folds and the 1000 random splits of the analysis scripts

study_split: original pipeline (original_notebooks/Step0): ten random patient-level partitions of the 291 patients with cores and follow-up (test fraction 0.33); partition RND-1 (the second) was used, required by the original protocol to be balanced in the clinical variables then available: 194 training and 97 hold-out patients; 13 hold-out patients were excluded before survival modeling because their H&E images were judged unusable on pathological review (clinical/clinical_excluded_holdout13.csv); the other 84 are in pipeline_outputs/sur.csv (test cohort)

encoder_checkpoints.validation_set: hold-out block (97 hold-out patients and the one training patient without a defined label); patch-level AUC computed after every epoch
encoder_checkpoints.rule: ResNet50: highest validation AUC (deployed); ResNet18, DenseNet121: as set in original_notebooks/Step1.2; CrossFormer: last completed epoch (10 of 16 planned)
